scope: Malawi medical discovery — Kamuzu University of Health Sciences School of Medicine and Oral Health

verifiedFacts.claim: KUHeS offers Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery among its full-time undergraduate programmes.
KUHeS's MBBS page describes a five-year programme with a strong science foundation, early patient contact and a transition to clinical training in third year.
For 2025/26 public-university selection, Malawi's NCHE lists the KUHeS MBBS as a six-year programme including foundation year, with stated MSCE/A-level subject requirements and 110 enrolment spaces.

KUHeS identifies Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital as the principal training hub, Kamuzu Central Hospital as a third-year MBBS training site, and Mangochi District Hospital as an undergraduate family-medicine rotation hub.
Malawi's NCHE accredited the KUHeS institution with conditions in its December 2024 council determinations.
NCHE's accredited-programme publication lists the KUHeS Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery programme.

holdReasons: The official MBBS page calls the programme five years while the current NCHE selection listing gives six years including foundation year; the profile needs an explicit current reconciliation before publication.
Current official MBBS fee and student-support evidence was not sufficiently assembled for the required payload fields.
nextAction: Obtain current KUHeS MBBS fee and student-support publications and reconcile the programme duration with the registrar before completing the field-level review and publishing.
